title: Player
description: Player body, health, loadout, and Quake-style movement constants. Units are Quake units and seconds.

weapons.description: Weapon ids (keys in weapons.json) the player carries.

starting_weapon.description: Weapon id held at spawn; must be in weapons.

max_ground_speed.description: Top running speed, units per second.

stop_speed.description: Quake sv_stopspeed: below this speed, friction acts as if at this speed.

air_wish_speed_cap.description: Airborne wish speed is capped to this (Quake 1 uses 30), which allows air strafing.

jump_velocity.description: Upward speed at the start of a jump, units per second.

step_height.description: Tallest step walked up without jumping.
